page.layout: One page of running text, set in one column. Below the text, a block of Arabic verse set as one stanza, four lines. No marginal notes. Bottom right: catchword "In-". Bottom left: signature "Qq 3".

main_text.p: non esse verum, ac legitimum Concilij Nicæni. De hoc enim nobis cum Hottingero, & Symmystis inpræsens controuersia non est: Sed utrum Romani Pontificis Monarchiam in suis Symbolicis scriptis asserant Orientales illæ Nationes, an vero cum Reformatis in hoc conueniant? Nobis enim sa-tis est inpræsens ostendere, Canonem hunc pro vero, ac legitimo Nicæno haberi a Chaldæis, Syris, & Arabibus, nempe Melchitis, Maronitis, Iacobitis, Nestorianis & Coptitis, quibus adde Æthiopes, in quorum omnium Conciliorum editionibus hic extat Canon, & pro Nicæno habetur; refertur que præterea in suarum Ecclesiarum Constitutionibus cap. De Patriarchis. De hoc vide quæ diximus par. 2. cap. 14. & seqq. nostri Eutychij vindicati. Garrit igitur Hottingerus hic, vt & alibi, atque gannit, suaque conficitur rabie, nulla veritatis habita ratione; nihil tamen in Christum Domini proficiens. Quamobrem audiat illud Arabis Poëtæ, in ipsum pene compositum.
اصبر على حين الحسود فـ[?]اني صبرك قاتله فالنار تأكل بعضها ان لم تجد ما تأكله

page.notes: The Arabic verse is printed as four lines in Arabic script; I have transcribed it as one stanza. "فاني" is uncertain (marked). The Arabic letters are small and the scan is slightly blurred, so the vowelling and final letters of the fourth line are not fully certain. Running head: none printed. Page number 613 is printed at the top right. Left edge shows scan border and show-through, omitted.
